items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Attacks started on September 4th, 2026, and Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 7th, 2026, for this critical flaw (CVSS 10.0).

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source to resolve a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of CVE-2026-75650 being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical and important vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications have emerged that threat actors are attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B, part of APSB26-92, could enable a security-feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
